title: I think I might have been to the hotel once. Is this accurate to anyone else's account of the hotel?

classification.question_topic: Asking whether their described 'hotel' matches others' accounts of the hotel in Mall World.

meta.final_emotion: unnerving feeling that I did something wrong and needed to leave immediately

qualities.raw_description: Luxury interior; dark and warm colored walls and lighting; dark brown wood; red velvet or dark leather furniture; yellow/orange lighting. Needed certain clearances/permission to get to higher layers.

position.relative_to: highest level / top floor of the hotel

qualities.raw_description: Super fancy dinner party. Top floor was only really one room, ~20x50 ft. Long dining table with fancy spread, silverware; table slightly off to the left side to make room for people to stand and congregate. People dressed their best (suits and dresses); some seated, some standing and chatting; no more than ~20 people.

locations.location_name: short hall near back of top room

position.relative_to: near the back of the top-floor dinner party room

qualities.raw_description: Short hall leading to another room; no doors.

position.relative_to: off the short hall; running parallel to the top-floor dinner party room

qualities.raw_description: Another room about the same size or a bit smaller than the first; runs parallel. Another table centered in the room. Men in business suits talking. When they noticed the dreamer entered, they stopped and stared.

connections.qualities: Elevators were more like fancy booths that would take you to the higher levels; access/permission needed for higher layers; dreamer somehow got access/permission to the highest level.
Short hall near the back of the room; no doors.
Turned the corner from the short hall into the second room.
Quickly descending on the booth elevator after returning to the previous room.

interactions.description: Needed certain clearances/permission (or something similar) to get to higher layers; dreamer somehow got access/permission to the highest level.
Attended a super fancy dinner party wearing a fancy dress; people in suits and dresses were seated and standing around chatting (no more than ~20 people).

entities_involved.description: Well-dressed party attendees in suits and dresses; some at the table, some standing and chatting.

interactions.description: Entered the parallel room and saw men in business suits talking around a centered table; when they noticed the dreamer, they stopped and stared as if the dreamer wasn't supposed to be there; dreamer carefully backed away.

entities_involved.description: Men in business suits talking to each other; stopped and stared when the dreamer entered.

interactions.description: Returned to the previous room and decided not to stay on the top level; quickly descended via the booth elevator due to an unnerving feeling they did something wrong and needed to leave immediately.

extraction.extraction_notes: Recurrence is ambiguous: title suggests possibly a one-time visit ('once') but classification flags include recurring_dream due to the broader 'Mall World hotel' framing; no explicit recurrence stated in narrative. Lighting is described for the hotel generally (yellow/orange, warm/dark); specific room lighting not separately described.
